overview_description.description: TesterArmy provides an AI-powered QA testing platform for websites and mobile applications. The product uses agent-based testing to launch real browsers, navigate interfaces like a user, and evaluate results based on test instructions written in plain language. It supports web, mobile web, iOS, and Android builds, handling authentication flows such as stored credentials, OAuth, and one-time passwords. Teams can connect GitHub and other CI pipelines to run checks on pull requests, schedule production monitoring, or trigger tests via webhooks. Each run produces screenshots, recordings, and structured bug reports that are accessible in a dashboard, via CLI, or directly on pull requests. The platform also offers integrations with tools like Slack, Discord, Vercel, and Expo and provides APIs and documentation for development workflows.
